newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar stock index ticks down in weak trade.
newsitem.headline: Qatar stock index ticks down in weak trade.

text.p: Shares at Qatar's unofficial stock market continued to chalk up gains in the week to Thursday but poor trading and a decline in two shares drove the index slightly down, brokers said.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 18-share index finished a shade lower at 127.96 points against 128.01 the previous week.
Dealers said trade faltered because of an increase in the interest rate on bank deposits to 6.75 percent from 6.5.
The increase, announced by Qatar's central bank on April 5, "took away some of the investors' spare funds from the stock market to banks," one broker said.
"The trading was so poor that even the rising stocks could not lift the index," he said.
During the week, six shares rose, two declined and nine were unchanged. Trading in one -- Qatar Flour Mills -- was suspended ahead of its annual general meeting scheduled for Saturday.

Among the gainers, Doha Bank Ltd rose five riyals to 323 and Qatar Islamic Bank one riyal to 133. Al Khaleej Insurance and Qatar General Insurance advanced five riyals each to 265 and 640 respectively and Qatar Cement won two riyals to 327. Qatar Cinema also clocked up five riyals to 200.
The decliners were the Commercial Bank of Qatar which shed three riyals to 315 and Qatar Shipping which slipped one riyal to 44.
